usage: The word 表弟 refers specifically to a younger male cousin from your mother's side.
Use 表弟 when talking about family members who are male cousins younger than you on your maternal side.
This noun can be used as the subject or object in a sentence to describe your relationship with your cousin.
When speaking, you can add more details about your 表弟, such as age or activities, but the core meaning stays the same.
It is not used to refer to paternal cousins or female cousins; those have different terms.
